Aisha Khan: Heads-up: we have duplicate candidate profiles for the same emails created by overlapping feeds. Interviewers are getting double invites and scorecards are split between profiles.
Samir Patel: Which feeds? jobmatch webhook or vendor CSV?
Aisha Khan: Both. Jobmatch webhook arrived, then vendor CSV import created a second profile with slightly different name casing. Our dedupe only used email_lower in some paths, but not consistently.
Noah Park: Impact summary: 36 duplicate emails -> 72 profiles. Some interviews were scheduled off the old profile; training badges linked to the other.
Maya Rodriguez: Oof. That explains the confusion in yesterday's panel. Need to merge and notify interviewers. Pause outbound invites?
Samir Patel: Pausing invite dispatcher now. Running a duplicates query: ```SELECT email, array_agg(id) AS ids FROM candidates WHERE created_at>='2026-06-01' GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(*)>1;```
Recruiting Bot: Query complete: 36 emails, 72 candidate rows matched.
Samir Patel: Plan: 1) Run idempotent merge script that picks canonical profile by latest_updated_at, migrates interviews, scorecards, notes, and external_training_ids. 2) Reconcile badge assignments and re-run training sync. 3) Add webhook dedupe middleware: reject create if email_lower exists OR create a join record instead. 4) Add a 48h duplicate-alert to vendor-import pipeline and a CI check for normalization of names/emails.
Aisha Khan: Also need a list for Comms so Maya can send a short note to affected interviewers: explain merge and ask to verify assigned scorecard.
Maya Rodriguez: Draft in #people-ops-drafts: "Hi all — we merged duplicate candidate profiles that caused duplicate invites. We've consolidated interviews and scorecards; please review your upcoming interviews and flag any mismatches."
Noah Park: Retro action: require vendor-provided stable candidate_id + source_feed_id in onboarding, and add e2e test for dedupe behaviour.
Samir Patel: I'll open the PR for dedupe middleware and the merge job. Will run merge in staging first and share a dry-run report.
Aisha Khan: Assignments: Samir - merge job + middleware + tests; Noah - pause/verify dispatcher + staging run; Maya - comms + legal review; Aisha - vendor escalation and incident log. Blocking until dry-run looks clean. :thumbsup:
